scope.paper_mechanism: A model-allocation portfolio trades private predictive risk against losses from correlated errors, with a cap on average predictive risk.
scope.miniature_comparison: Allocate 1,000 synthetic farms across nine error models using a constrained optimizer, uniform allocation, or the lowest estimated-risk model; score fresh simulated social loss.
preserved_assumptions: Shared and idiosyncratic Gaussian errors with controllable cross-model correlation.
Simplex allocation and an average estimated-risk cap.
Fresh evaluation shocks are shared across methods.
simplifications: Synthetic risks replace agricultural benchmark calibration.
Correlation and loss parameters are known to the portfolio optimizer.
Continuous weights are rounded into farm counts and benchmark risks are noisy.
unsupported_claims: Observed crop-yield improvements or monetary/ecological welfare.
A cap guaranteed for each farm or for true risk under noisy estimated risks.

evidence.finding: The source objective includes private risk, correlated systemic loss, and a population-average risk cap.
The objective and constraints implement that restricted modeled comparison, with estimated rather than true risks.
All arms receive the same noisy risks. Portfolio optimization additionally assumes known correlation and loss parameters; scope that oracle information explicitly.
Risk, benchmark, and evaluation generators are separated and independent of method.
Underlying evaluation shocks are common; allocation changes which model-specific shocks reach each farm. Identical final errors are not expected.
Evaluation shocks are separate from benchmark risk-estimation noise.
The primary metric is average modeled private plus systemic loss; lower is better. cap_ok separately checks true risk.
0.01 is in synthetic social-loss units; no external welfare meaning or signed threshold justification exists.
SLSQP results are clipped and checked for feasibility/objective improvement, with monoculture fallback. Convergence and repeated-worker behavior remain unprobed.
The optimizer uses the same structural objective as the generator, so gains partly check model-consistent optimization.
True-risk regret can exceed the estimated-risk cap. Admission must inspect this diagnostic, not only the social-loss label.

rationale: Assistant draft only. Separate modeled loss improvements from constraint satisfaction under noisy risks. Verify optimizer fallback/feasibility and justify the synthetic-unit margin.

assistant_assessment.evidence_scope: Primary method sections and static implementation inspected; historical caches analyzed. No new lab executions, parameter probes, independent confirmation, or model evaluations.
blockers: Separate modeled loss improvements from constraint satisfaction under noisy risks.
Verify optimizer fallback/feasibility and justify the synthetic-unit margin.
owner_actions: Review the restricted model-consistency scope and known covariance assumptions.
Inspect cap_ok across contexts and seeds before making a constrained-benefit claim.
Probe SLSQP failure/fallback and shared exogenous shocks in versioned fixtures.
